title: Sorting by height
blurb: The reference line: sensors, a diverter and two counters. Sorts tall cartons down a chute and lets short ones pass.

title: Start / stop station
blurb: A conveyor and an operator panel. Momentary buttons, a latching E-stop, and a lamp that has to reflect the real state.

title: Tank level control
blurb: Analog end to end. A modulating valve and a level transmitter, with outflow that varies with level — a PID tuned full will overshoot empty.

title: Light curtain sorting
blurb: Sorting on a measurement instead of two bits. The curtain reports how tall each carton is, so you choose the threshold in code.

title: Roller line with weighing
blurb: A roller deck, a checkweigher and an inductive sensor that sees metal only — cardboard passes it as if the lane were empty.
